text:
Mia: Quick evening status — release train is green overall but cherry-pick queue has 3 blocking PRs (one flaky e2e, one infra change that needs a backport, one docs-only with CI tag mismatch).
Dan: Which PRs specifically? pinging owners.
Chandra: I'm on PR #4823 (kv-cache revert). Tests fail on multi-GPU integration. I can try a backport to the release branch tonight, but might need a rollback if it blocks the cut.
Mia: @Chandra thanks — prioritize backport. If it doesn't land cleanly, let's revert the change from main on the train.
Liam: FYI infra saw a p99 spike on serving-1 after the batcher config bump at ~18:30 UTC.
ops-bot: alert: p99 latency increased 27% on serving-1 at 18:32 UTC — rolling window 5m
Julie: Taking the canary rollback now (I'll re-run smoke tests after). I'll post the command/output.
Julie: rollback cmd: ```./deploy rollback --env=canary --train=rail-7 --reason=p99-spike``` 
Julie: rollback output: ```Starting rollback... removing canary pods... done. Smoke tests: PASS.``` :white_check_mark:
Dan: CR ping to @Mia and @Chandra on the backport branch when ready. I'll queue the cherry-picks once tests pass.
Mia: Great — once rollback stabilized, please re-trigger the cut readiness check. If any blocker remains at 21:00 UTC we escalate to oncall.
Liam: Noted. I'll keep a watch on serving-1 for regressions.
Chandra: Backport pushed to release/v1.8 as branch backport/kvcache-4823. Running CI now.
Mia: Thanks. Small ask — add a short changelog note for the revert so support knows what changed.
release-bot: release-check: canary status OK, pending: 3 cherry-picks, blockers: 0 (after Julie rollback and Chandra backport pending CI)
Mia: Awesome. If CI on backport flakes, Dan will coordinate a hotfix. Otherwise, proceeding with cut at 20:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
Dan: I'll send the final go/no-go at 20:15 UTC.
Liam: 👍
Chandra: CI passed on backport — ready for cherry-pick queue.
Mia: Copy — thanks everyone. Any other quick blockers?
Julie: none from infra now.
Mia: closing out here — update me if anything changes.
